data.body: **[P3] Approach: remove the need for an untested deletion path.** Rule 4 requires a test that fails when each branch is removed or inverted. Both callers request only `CREATE_COMPLETE` or `UPDATE_COMPLETE`, and the deployment unit tests mock `wait_stack`; this `DELETE_COMPLETE` branch has no such test or reachable use in the suite. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and simplify the waiter around the resource lifecycle the harness actually supports.
